title: Tandoori salmon with cucumber raita
summary: Salmon fillets rubbed with tandoori spices and yoghurt, roasted hot, then served with a cool cucumber raita and a small portion of rice.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Stir half the yoghurt with the tandoori masala, garlic, ginger, oil and half the lemon juice. Coat the salmon and set it on a lined tin.
steps.tip: Line the tin. Tandoori marinade bakes on and is a pain to scrub.

steps.instruction: Roast the salmon until it flakes and the spice paste has darkened at the edges. Start the rice at the same time: cover it with the water and a pinch of salt and cook for 10 minutes, then steam off the heat.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze out the water with your hands, and stir it into the remaining yoghurt with the mint, remaining lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Slice the rest of the cucumber.
Serve the salmon with the rice, the sliced cucumber and a spoon of raita.

image.alt: Spice-rubbed salmon with rice, salad and lime on a metal plate
